title: Circle colors on black
slide_intent: Expose the overlap against black because color relationships must stay distinct across light and dark backgrounds.
strategic_value: A controlled lightness relationship can maintain both legibility and the impression of transparency.
demonstration: Red and yellow circles intersect in bright orange at the center of a black field.
practical_value: Evaluate overlap visibility alongside the pale-background signature in MC02.

content_islands.name: Color symbol
content_islands.spec: Center the red circle at left and yellow circle at right with an orange intersection.

content_islands.name: Ground
content_islands.spec: Retain the uninterrupted black field around the symbol.

reference_purposes.Intent: Pentagram states that the three hues were tested for visibility on white, black and intermediate backgrounds.
reference_purposes.Expression: The black field isolates the red, orange and yellow relationships.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Pentagram explicitly states that the final overlap is lighter than the red and darker than the yellow.

ingredient.name: Three-color circle mark
ingredient.role: Preserve recognition and express connection through overlapping colors.
ingredient.application: Keep the overlap lighter than red and darker than yellow; evaluate against different backgrounds.
ingredient.scope: Historical 2016 Pentagram case study; not a current master guideline or numeric production specification.
